notes.subject: graunpela het
notes.rationale: שיבה i min 'olpela taim / olgeta yia' — Tok Pisin i tok 'graunpela het', tok bilong het tasol

notes.subject: tsedek
notes.rationale: צדקה i min 'stret pasin, tsedek' — mi holim tok Hibru long palaut

notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Hibru i no gat pronoun — em i stap long bracket

notes.subject: olgeta yia
notes.rationale: Ves i tok olpela taim i wankain krown — i skelim gutpela pasin long ol yia bilong man

translation: Krown bilong glori em i graunpela het, long rot bilong tsedek ⟨em⟩ i kamap.
